parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 14 - Sword Art Online

Overview

Infinity Mage is a Secret Limited unit unit.

Evolving

Infinity Mage can evolve into Infinity Mage (Endless) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Infinity Mage
x10 Demonic Spellbook
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Red)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Infinity Mage (Endless)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5,000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Trivia
